content.text:
Campaign complete for case-102.

**Result: Resolved** — Candidate 2, P = 11.3505 days (K = 33.20 m/s), with final support 0.99999, exceeding theta (0.997). Used 5 of 6 observations, 1 unused.

Path: started with candidates 1 (P=0.918d) and 2 (P=11.35d) as the dominant pair (support 0.56 / 0.40). First observation (slot 2) pushed candidate 1 to 0.82; a confirmation observation (slot 4) flipped the lead to candidate 2 and unexpectedly revived candidate 0, revealing a noisy earlier point. A discriminating observation (slot 5) eliminated candidate 0 cleanly, leaving the 1-vs-2 pair. Two more high-separation observations (slots 8, 21) drove candidate 2's support to 1.0, comfortably above threshold.
